structure: CSharp EmitCheckedIntegerConversion selects lower, upper, scalar-surrogate guards and delegates failure to common EmitTrapUnless. SLG emitInterpolationIntegerConversionChecks selects corresponding three guards but emits only trap/unreachable; text-slice/allocation paths already share emitRuntimeTrap with declaration identity and Windows/browser output.
branches: Retain source/destination range decisions, comparisons, single operand evaluation and original success continuations. Only route each failure through the existing common runtime trap output with the same explicit semantic code.
logic: First expose an ownerIndex-based common trap helper, retaining existing WhileValueRequest adapter. Numeric interpolation guards call that helper with their actual function owner. Reuse existing source declaration normalization, escaped diagnostic bytes and target-specific Windows/browser output.
diagnostics: CSharp10 checks pin main identity, existing qualified declaration identity, exit0 versus trap0xC000001D, exact empty stdout on failure, and valid boundaries. No per-compiler oracle or silent fallback is introduced. Text-runtime availability for the new call sites must be verified before Native acceptance.
